notes: A new look for the login and registration screens. Terms & Conditions to accept once after registering (your books are yours; nothing in them belongs to blitzbook.co.in). Every entry now has a number and a link: invoices, challans, purchases, notes, receipts, payments, journal entries (JV-), expenses (EXP-) and contacts (C-); tap a number in any list to open the entry, hold it to copy its link (https://blitzbook.co.in/open/#number), or use Open # on the dashboard. Save Draft stays at the bottom of the invoice screen (Drafts lists them); the purchase and journal editors have Save Draft too. The invoice screen has a Back button to the screen it came from, besides Dashboard. Journal entries show Debit and Credit in their own columns; Stock in Hand shows In and Out with a Columns button; Customer and Supplier lists take your own columns (Columns button). The classic print layout labels the Taxable Value row.
